_meta: Course units. `words` are decodable using only letters taught up to and including that unit (scripts/check_decodable.py); each word is [urdu, roman, english, urdu_vowelled]. `sentences` are the unit's Read-lesson sentences, `passage` its short passage, same 4-field shape; both are built from words taught in this or an earlier unit (sight words from the unit that teaches their letters) by scripts/apply_new_texts.py. Word evidence (corpus counts + open dictionary entry) is in data/word_evidence.json, sources in data/SOURCES.md.

passage: کل عید ہے۔ احمد اور علی بہت خوش ہیں۔ دونوں مسجد جاتے ہیں۔ مسجد کے بعد وہ خالہ کے گھر جاتے ہیں۔ خالہ کا گھر باغ کے قریب ہے۔ خالہ کے پاس حلوہ، کباب اور نان ہیں۔ علی کو حلوہ پسند ہے۔ احمد کو کباب پسند ہیں۔ خالہ کہتی ہے: خوب کھانا۔ دونوں خوب کھانا کھاتے ہیں۔ شام کو دونوں اپنے گھر جاتے ہیں۔ عید بہت اچھی ہوتی ہے۔ خالد کا خرگوش سفید ہے۔ خالد اپنے خرگوش کو گھاس دیتا ہے۔ سب بہت خوش ہیں۔ علی اپنا قلم دیکھتا ہے۔ احمد کا قلم میز پر ہے۔

kal ʻīd hai. aḥmad aur ʻalī bahut k͟hush haiṉ. donoṉ masjid jāte haiṉ. masjid ke baʻd woh k͟hāla ke ghar jāte haiṉ. k͟hāla kā ghar bāg͟h ke qarīb hai. k͟hāla ke pās ḥalwa, kabāb aur nān haiṉ. ʻalī ko ḥalwa pasand hai. aḥmad ko kabāb pasand haiṉ. k͟hāla kahtī hai: k͟hūb khānā. donoṉ k͟hūb khānā khāte haiṉ. shām ko donoṉ apne ghar jāte haiṉ. ʻīd bahut achchhī hotī hai. k͟hālid kā k͟hargosh safīd hai. k͟hālid apne k͟hargosh ko ghās detā hai. sab bahut k͟hush haiṉ. ʻalī apnā qalam dekhtā hai. aḥmad kā qalam mez par hai.

Tomorrow is Eid. Ahmad and Ali are very happy. Both go to the mosque. After the mosque they go to aunt's house. Aunt's house is near the garden. Aunt has halwa, kebab and naan. Ali likes halwa. Ahmad likes kebab. Aunt says: eat well. Both eat plenty of food. In the evening both go to their own home. Eid is very nice. Khalid's rabbit is white. Khalid gives his rabbit grass. Everyone is very happy. Ali looks at his pen. Ahmad's pen is on the table.

ṣābir ek ẕahīn shāgird hai. ṣubḥ ṣābir ne ṣāf qamīẓ lī. phir woh iskūl gayā. iskūl meṉ riyāẓī kā maẓmūn hai. riyāẓī bahut ẓarūrī hai. ustād kahtā hai: ṣafḥa dekho. ṣābir ṣaḥīḥ jawāb likhtā hai. ustād kahtā hai: bahut achchhā. ṣābir kā t̤ot̤ā ṣaḥn meṉ hai. is kā t̤ot̤ā ẕarā baṛā hai. shām ko ṣābir apnā t̤ot̤ā dekhtā hai. t̤ot̤ā kahtā hai: ṣābir, mubārak ho. khānā ṣiḥḥat ke liye ẓarūrī hai. ṣābir kī māṉ g͟hiẕā detī hai. sab k͟hush haiṉ. t̤āriq ṣubḥ iskūl jātā hai. t̤āriq kā t̤ot̤ā bahut achchhā hai.

Sabir is a clever pupil. In the morning Sabir took a clean shirt. Then he went to school. In school there is the subject of maths. Maths is very important. The teacher says: look at the page. Sabir writes the right answer. The teacher says: very good. Sabir's parrot is in the courtyard. His parrot is a bit big. In the evening Sabir looks at his parrot. The parrot says: Sabir, congratulations! Food is necessary for health. Sabir's mother gives food. Everyone is happy. Tariq goes to school in the morning. Tariq's parrot is very good.

صابِر ایک ذَہین شاگِرد ہَے۔ صُبْح صابِر نے صاف قَمیض لی۔ پِھر وُہ اِسکول گَیا۔ اِسکول مَیں رِیاضی کا مَضمون ہَے۔ رِیاضی بَہُت ضَروری ہَے۔ اُستاد کَہتا ہَے: صَفحَہ دیکھو۔ صابِر صَحیح جَواب لِکھتا ہَے۔ اُستاد کَہتا ہَے: بَہُت اَچّھا۔ صابِر کا طوطا صَحْن مَیں ہَے۔ اِس کا طوطا ذَرا بَڑا ہَے۔ شام کو صابِر اَپنا طوطا دیکھتا ہَے۔ طوطا کَہتا ہَے: صابِر، مُبارَک ہو۔ کھانا صِحَّت کے لِیے ضَروری ہَے۔ صابِر کی ماں غِذا دیتی ہَے۔ سَب خُوش ہَیں۔ طارِق صُبْح اِسکول جاتا ہَے۔ طارِق کا طوطا بَہُت اَچّھا ہَے۔

āj itwār hai. bhāʾī apnī sāʾīkal par dukān jātā hai. dukān par āṭā, ālū aur miṭhāʾī hai. bhāʾī ne ۲ seb aur ek ām liye. phir woh ghar ātā hai. ammī chāʾe detī hai. chāʾe meṉ ۲ chamach chīnī hai. bhāʾī kahtā hai: shukriya ammī. ammī kahtī hai: koʾī masʾala nahīṉ. abbā kahtā hai: āj mausam achchhā hai. āsmān nīlā hai. ham ۴ baje bāg͟h jāʾeṉ ge. bhāʾī ko bāg͟h bahut pasand hai. āj āsmān ṣāf hai. abbā kī sāʾīkal naʾī hai. bhāʾī kahtā hai: āo, ham bāg͟h jāʾeṉ. ammī āj miṭhāʾī detī hai. ham sab āj k͟hush haiṉ.

Today is Sunday. Brother goes to the shop on his bicycle. At the shop there is flour, potatoes and sweets. Brother took 2 apples and a mango. Then he comes home. Mother gives tea. There are 2 spoons of sugar in the tea. Brother says: thank you, mother! Mother says: no problem. Dad says: the weather is good today. The sky is blue. We will go to the garden at 4 o'clock. Brother likes the garden very much. The sky is clear today. Dad's bicycle is new. Brother says: come, let's go to the garden. Mother gives sweets today. We are all happy today.

itwār ko ham rel se karāchī jāte haiṉ. ham ṣubḥ isṭeshan par āte haiṉ. rel bahut lambī hai. abbū ne tīn ṭikaṭ liye. māṉ ke pās biryānī aur parāṭhā haiṉ. rel meṉ ek būṛhā ādmī hai. woh kahtā hai: karāchī bahut baṛā shahr hai. wahāṉ samundar hai. shām ko ham karāchī meṉ haiṉ. k͟hāla kā ghar samundar ke qarīb hai. k͟hāla hameṉ chāʾe aur biskuṭ detī hai. rāt ko ham sab k͟hush haiṉ. ham pīr ko wāpas lāhaur jāte haiṉ. sitambar meṉ bārish hotī hai. disambar meṉ bahut sardī hotī hai. pākistān bahut achchhā mulk hai.

On Sunday we go to Karachi by train. We come to the station in the morning. The train is very long. Dad took three tickets. Mother has biryani and paratha. In the train there is an old man. He says: Karachi is a very big city. There is the sea there. In the evening we are in Karachi. Aunt's house is near the sea. Aunt gives us tea and biscuits. At night we are all happy. On Monday we go back to Lahore. It rains in September. In December it is very cold. Pakistan is a very good country.
